items.title: Savneet Talwar, Anna Boghiguian, Iris van Herpen

items.title: 2,300-Year-Old Fragment of Homer’s “Odyssey” Now on View at The Met
items.summary: The papyrus fragment contains three lines from Book 20 of the epic that don’t appear in the modern text.

items.title: Could This New Legislation Protect Historic Sites From Trump's Wrath?
items.summary: As a heavily Trump-appointed council tries to loosen preservation safeguards, Democrats are spearheading the PRESERVE Act to protect publicly commissioned art.

items.title: The Lost Pearls of New York City
items.summary: Alan Michelson's public art installation “The Oyster” on Governors Island conjures up the overlooked history of Indigenous shell middens.
